title: LE-GDA: Layer Ensemble Gaussian Discriminant Analysis for Training-Free Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training-free few-shot adaptation of vision-language models typically constructs a classifier from CLIP's final projected image representation, leaving intermediate representations unused. Combining them is not straightforward. Class scores from different representations differ in spread by orders of magnitude for the same query. Direct averaging allocates influence by numerical scale rather than predictive information. We propose Layer-Ensemble Gaussian Discriminant Analysis (LE-GDA), a method that fits regularized shared-covariance discriminants independently to intermediate and final representations extracted in one frozen encoder pass. LE-GDA standardizes each discriminant's class scores per query, selects a small representation multiset on labeled validation data, and combines it with the zero-shot classifier without gradient-based optimization. translated_title: LE-GDA：用于免训练少样本CLIP适配的层集成高斯判别分析
translated_abstract: 免训练的视觉-语言模型少样本适配通常仅从CLIP的最终投影图像表示构建分类器，而将中间层表示闲置未用。将这些表示组合起来并非易事：对于同一查询，来自不同表示的类别分数在数值分布范围上相差数个数量级，直接平均会依据数值大小而非预测信息来分配影响力。我们提出层集成高斯判别分析（LE-GDA），该方法在单次冻结编码器前向传播中提取的中间表示和最终表示上，独立拟合正则化的共享协方差判别器。LE-GDA对每个判别器的类别分数按查询进行标准化，在带标签的验证数据上选择一个小的表示多重集，并将其与零样本分类器组合，全程无需基于梯度的优化。在11个数据集、四种CLIP骨干网络、五种样本数量以及三个独立采样（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LE-GDA方法，通过对CLIP多层表示独立拟合高斯判别器并按查询标准化后集成，实现无需梯度优化的免训练少样本视觉-语言模型适配。
